Package com.bilt.pos.session.settlement

Class PartialApprovalDecision

java.lang.Object
com.bilt.pos.session.settlement.PartialApprovalDecision
public final class PartialApprovalDecision extends Object
The register's answer to SettlementFlow.onPartialCardApproval: what to do about the shortfall of a card payment that the terminal approved for less than it was asked for. The partial card payment itself stays committed unless the decision is abort().

A decision the settlement cannot carry out (addToNext() with no card payment left, an external(ExternalPayment) amount other than PartialCardApproval.getAmountDue()) is refused like an invalid SettlementRecovery: the settlement fails with INVALID_STATE, and the committed steps stand until a retried settle() or voidTransaction() reverses them.

  • Method Details

    • anotherCard

      public static PartialApprovalDecision anotherCard()
      Charge the shortfall as a new card payment right after this one, then continue with the planned payments. On the last card payment of the settlement this is the way to collect the shortfall on one more card.

    • addToNext

      public static PartialApprovalDecision addToNext()
      Add the shortfall to the next card payment: the next planned amount, or the remainder payment when no planned amount is left. Valid only while a card payment is left after this one; on the last card payment of the settlement it is refused, and anotherCard() charges the shortfall on one more card instead.

    • external

      public static PartialApprovalDecision external(ExternalPayment payment)
      Record a register-managed payment, such as cash, for everything the card phase still owes, and end the card phase. Every committed card payment stays. The amount must equal PartialCardApproval.getAmountDue(). The payment is recorded as an EXTERNAL_PAYMENT movement, as with SettlementRecovery.external.

    • abort

      public static PartialApprovalDecision abort()
      Reverse every committed charge-side step, this partial card payment and the earlier card payments included, and fail the settlement as DECLINED: the same unwind as SettlementRecovery.abort(). Card brand rules require a partial approval that the sale does not complete to be reversed, so this is the answer when the shopper cannot pay the shortfall.
